--- a/apps/worker/exceptions.py
+++ b/apps/worker/exceptions.py
@@ -1,3 +1,14 @@
+"""Worker exceptions.
+
+All retry decisions flow through ProcessingError.retryable: the
+orchestrator consults this flag and no other signal when deciding
+whether to re-queue a failed job.
+"""
+
+class ProcessingError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, message, retryable=False):
+        super().__init__(message)
+        self.retryable = retryable
